data.name: Aguistin
data.gender_notes: Aguistin is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin agere, to drive or lead. Derived from the words aguare, meaning 'to drive', and statin, meaning 'place' or 'station'. In Christian tradition, represents the strength and agility to stand firm in faith. The name Aguistin carries the meaning “Strength, Agility” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Aguistin usually hope their child will grow to embody strength, agility and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of inner strength and agility on the spiritual journey.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aguistin total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_latin.name: Aguistin
